description: Client-side aim assist for Minecraft 1.21.11, made for players with disabilities.

mods.name: AimAssist
mods.description: Client-side aim assist for players with disabilities. Nudges your crosshair toward a target inside a horizontal wedge in front of you, the way a controller's rotational aim assist does. Your own mouse input always passes through unchanged.

releases.notes:
Initial release for Minecraft 1.21.11.

A client-side aim assist for players with disabilities. The assist adds a rotation on top of your own mouse input, which always passes through unchanged: no slowdown, no damping, and the Y axis is never touched.

Targets are selected from a horizontal wedge in front of you, so pitch does not affect whether the assist engages. All parameters are configurable in-game through ModMenu.

Requires Fabric API. ModMenu is optional and only needed for the settings screen.
